answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The lagoon cap is checked at intake and kernel exposes the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a reef tag. That is 21 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
